subject: English
title: Who Can Fly?
subtitle: Baby Sparrow's kite
hero_picture: A little yellow baby sparrow and a red mother sparrow on a branch, a red kite with blue wings and a yellow tail stuck in a tall tree.

sections.heading: Kites in the valley
text: Children were flying kites in a valley.
Red, yellow, green: kites of many colours!
'Mamma, I too want a kite,' said Baby Sparrow.
sections.caption: Kites in the valley
sections.picture: Children flying colourful kites in a sunny valley, two sparrows watching from a branch.

sections.heading: A red kite
text: Baby Sparrow and Mamma made a kite.
A red kite with blue wings and a yellow tail.
The kite rose up in the sky.
sections.caption: A red kite
sections.picture: A small yellow sparrow pulling the string of a red kite with blue wings and a yellow tail up in the sky.

sections.heading: SNAP!
text: The kite got stuck in the branch of a tree.
sections.caption: SNAP!
sections.picture: A red kite caught in the branches of a big tree, a sad little yellow sparrow on the ground.

sections.heading: Can you fly?
text: The cow said, 'I can only walk.'
The snake said, 'I can only crawl.' The rabbit said, 'I can only hop.'
The fish said, 'We can only swim.'
sections.caption: Can you fly?
sections.picture: A cow, a rat snake, a rabbit and fish in a pond near a tree with a kite, a sparrow asking them.

sections.heading: Mamma can fly
text: 'Mamma, who can get my kite back?'
'Ha ha, I can,' said Mamma Sparrow. She flew up and got it.
'One day I too will fly like you!'
sections.caption: Mamma can fly
sections.picture: A red mother sparrow flying with the red kite in her beak, the baby sparrow cheering below.

rhyme: The cow can walk, the snake can crawl,
The rabbit hops over the wall,
The fish can swim, but who can fly?
activity: Act it out: walk like a cow, crawl like a snake, hop like a rabbit and fly like a bird.
talk: Who could get the kite back?
summary: Animals move in different ways; Mamma Sparrow could fly and got the kite back.

questions.explanation: Baby Sparrow said, 'I too want a kite.'

questions.prompt: Where did the kite get stuck?
questions.explanation: It got stuck in the branch of a tree.
'I can only hop. I can't fly.'
Mamma Sparrow flew up and took the kite.
